Author: Husk & Bone
Name: Yassify
Description: Pick a piece you're wearing (from a Penumbra mod) and give it YAS jiggle copied from the YAS body you have on, with live sliders per area - butt, chest, belly, thighs and more. Choose how it fits: as made, hugging the skin (leggings, bodysuits) or flowy (skirts, dresses). Tops and bottoms made for one Neolithe shape can be refit to another (XS - L, Almond, Hazelnut, Macadamia, Pushup, Neobelly, Buff...). Everything shows on your character live; nothing is written until you press Save, and the old file is backed up first so you can put it back.
Punchline: Make your outfits jiggle like your YAS body does - and refit Neolithe pieces to your size.
